note: DO NOT USE THE LEGEND H1 FIGURE AS A BASELINE. The Legend chronicle line 100 states a warm 200x200 redraw at 0.049 to 0.068 ms against a 0.20 ms bar, with the harness committed at clients/game/bin/examples/legend_redraw_bench.rs. The VERDICT stands: the classifier extraction did not blow the budget, which is what the hypothesis needed. THE FIGURE IS NOT FIT TO BASELINE ANYTHING, for two reasons found by checking rather than by rereading the close that produced it. FIRST: it was measured BEFORE the 593-commit absorption of main. Verified with git merge-base --is-ancestor cfa57745e 679ae15ab, which returns true — harness and numbers landed in the close commit, the absorption came after. That absorption changed the settlement-roster path materially, because main had INDEPENDENTLY extracted the same derivation into a shared plate settlements_of helper and the conflict resolution widened that shared helper to carry population. The measured path is not the merged path and nobody re-measured. SECOND: the box was not idle, and idle was a STATED PRECONDITION of the preregistration. Load 9 to 19 on twelve cores, shared with other Claude sessions. Every invocation internal spread stayed under the 1.4x re-measure threshold so the numbers are self-consistent, but self-consistent on a contended box is exactly what The Quadrat refused to pin when it measured 65.3, 65.6, 70.3 and 91.5 on one path and declined to pick a fifth number. GENERAL LESSON, and it is the fourth instance in this one campaign: a number is true AT A COMMIT, and a campaign that measures at task N and merges at task N plus an absorption has published a figure about code that no longer exists. If a later campaign needs your number as a baseline, either re-measure at the merge SHA or say plainly that you did not. The harness is committed precisely so re-measuring is cheap: cargo run --release --example legend_redraw_bench from clients/game/bin on a genuinely idle box. ALSO: the region fixture move in The Legend merge is THE SMALLER OF TWO. The Pavement decisions 0512 and 0513 unify the cube projection and shift every per-node layer under a RegionAddr by about 4.9 degrees at (0.5, 0.5) on face 0, including the relief field The Legend adds. That reconciliation is The Pavement to own; this note exists so nobody reads the first move as settling the matter.
